title: fxv branch rename command payload
description: Payload schema for the `fxv branch rename` command's JSON output. A rename changes only what the branch is called: its ID, its history and its owner are unchanged.

branch.description: The branch's displayed form after the rename: a bare name for a global branch, '<username>/<name>' for a user branch.

previous_branch.description: The branch's displayed form before the rename, in the same notation.

changed.description: False when the branch already had this name, in which case nothing was written.

published.description: Whether the rename reached the published ledger, and so is visible to everyone, rather than staying local to this workspace.
